moments.text: Handheld recording of an infrared screen: grainy grey background, a small dark spot held in a box at the crosshair centre.
The box drops and the dark spot drifts left away from the crosshair, fading as it nears the left side.
Only the empty crosshair and a small white marker remain; no spot is visible.
A faint dark spot appears right of the crosshair, grows darker, and the view pans to bring it onto the crosshair.
A tracking box locks onto the spot, which stays boxed at the crosshair to the end.
